name: Finite prior-source exposure scan for novelty v6 source proposal
scope: Finite prior local source corpus only. This is a provenance-backed finite scan, not a claim of universal, global, or exhaustive literature freshness. Capture occurred before v6 proposal/evidence/raw-source copies were written under references/external/sakana or a v6 archive; the current proposal and newly created study5 source-preparation archive are excluded by construction.

method.scan: Read every file of every type under the three explicit roots; extract PMID-context/URL IDs, recursively inspect JSON fields whose key contains PMID/PubMed, and parse PMID XML elements/ArticleId identifiers. Retain per-file SHA-256/byte count and each root snapshot digest.
method.placeholder_note: 99000001–99000003 occur as synthetic harness/test placeholder source identifiers, not prior public paper sources; their file origins are listed separately.
